microtheory.name: optimal_estimation_control
microtheory.definition: Optimal control + state estimation. LQR (Linear Quadratic Regulator), LQG (Linear Quadratic Gaussian), Kalman filter, particle filter, Model Predictive Control (MPC), H-infinity robust control. The mathematical framework for steering systems optimally under cost objectives + noise. Provides Jabberwock's runner/brain with the principled-optimization side of control: not just feedback that works, but feedback that minimizes a cost / maximizes utility under uncertainty.

concepts.name: optimal_control
concepts.definition: Choose control to minimize cost functional J = ∫(state cost + control cost) dt over trajectory. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-minimization.

concepts.name: cost_functional
concepts.definition: Quadratic in state + control: J = ∫(x^T Q x + u^T R u) dt. Q, R weight matrices. Substrate analogue: substrate's frustration objective.

concepts.name: bellman_equation
concepts.definition: V*(x) = min_u { L(x,u) + V*(f(x,u)) }. Foundation of dynamic programming. Substrate analogue: substrate's recursive optimal-value structure.

concepts.name: dynamic_programming_control
concepts.definition: Bellman. Solve optimal control backward from goal. Curse of dimensionality. Substrate analogue: substrate's backward induction.

concepts.name: pontryagins_principle
concepts.definition: Necessary condition for optimal control: Hamiltonian H = L + λ^T f maximized over u. Substrate analogue: substrate's adjoint-variable optimization.

concepts.name: hamilton_jacobi_bellman
concepts.definition: HJB equation: V_t + min_u {L + V_x^T f} = 0. Continuous-time dynamic programming. Substrate analogue: substrate's PDE characterization.

concepts.name: linear_quadratic_regulator
concepts.definition: LQR. Linear dynamics ẋ = Ax + Bu + quadratic cost. Closed-form solution: u = -Kx where K = R^{-1} B^T P, P solves Algebraic Riccati Equation. Robust to many disturbances. Substrate analogue: substrate's principal-component optimal control.

concepts.name: algebraic_riccati_equation
concepts.definition: ARE: A^T P + P A - P B R^{-1} B^T P + Q = 0. Solves LQR for infinite horizon. Symmetric positive-definite P. Substrate analogue: substrate's stationary-optimality fixed point.

concepts.name: lqr_gain
concepts.definition: K = R^{-1} B^T P. Optimal feedback gain matrix. Doesn't depend on initial state — universal optimal feedback. Substrate analogue: substrate's state-feedback weights.

concepts.name: robustness_lqr
concepts.definition: LQR has 60° phase margin + ∞ gain margin in classical SISO. Optimal AND robust. Substrate analogue: substrate's principled robustness.

concepts.name: kalman_filter
concepts.definition: Kalman 1960. Optimal state estimator for linear Gaussian dynamics. Recursive: predict step + update step. ẋ̂ = Aẋ̂ + Bu + K(y - Cẋ̂), K = PC^T R^{-1}. Substrate analogue: substrate's online Bayesian state estimator.

concepts.name: kalman_gain
concepts.definition: K_t = P_t C^T (CPC^T + R)^{-1}. Weight between prediction + measurement. Large K trusts measurement; small K trusts prediction. Substrate analogue: substrate's belief-update gain.

concepts.name: innovation_kalman
concepts.definition: y - Cẋ̂ — difference between measurement and prediction. Kalman update proportional to innovation. Substrate analogue: substrate's ΔF / prediction error.

concepts.name: covariance_propagation_kalman
concepts.definition: P_t+1 = A P_t A^T + Q. Predict step. Update: P_t+1 = (I - K_t C) P_t. Substrate analogue: substrate's belief-uncertainty evolution.

concepts.name: extended_kalman_filter
concepts.definition: EKF. Linearize nonlinear dynamics around current estimate. Standard for nonlinear estimation. Not optimal, but tractable. Substrate analogue: substrate's local-linear estimation.

concepts.name: unscented_kalman_filter
concepts.definition: UKF. Julier+Uhlmann 1997. Use sigma points to propagate distribution through nonlinearity. Better than EKF for strong nonlinearity. Substrate analogue: substrate's higher-order moment propagation.

concepts.name: lqg_control
concepts.definition: Linear Quadratic Gaussian. LQR + Kalman filter combined via separation principle. Estimate state, control as if it's certain. Substrate analogue: substrate's estimate-then-act optimal control.

concepts.name: separation_principle
concepts.definition: For LQG, optimal estimator + optimal controller designed independently. Combined solution still optimal. Foundation of certainty equivalence. Substrate analogue: substrate's perception-action separation.

concepts.name: certainty_equivalence
concepts.definition: Use estimate as if it were true state. Optimal in LQG. Approximation in general. Substrate analogue: substrate's point-estimate decision.

concepts.name: model_predictive_control
concepts.definition: MPC. At each step: solve finite-horizon optimization, apply first input, repeat. Handles constraints + nonlinearities. Dominates process industry. Substrate analogue: substrate's anticipation-based corrected action.

concepts.name: receding_horizon
concepts.definition: MPC's defining feature: optimization horizon recedes with time. Always plan H steps ahead from current state. Substrate analogue: substrate's continuously-replanning lookahead.

concepts.name: mpc_constraints
concepts.definition: MPC handles input + state constraints directly via constrained optimization. Hard advantage over LQR. Substrate analogue: substrate's constraint-aware action selection.

concepts.name: mpc_terminal_cost
concepts.definition: Terminal cost / set in finite-horizon MPC ensures stability. Lyapunov function on terminal state. Substrate analogue: substrate's bounded-horizon goal-completion.

concepts.name: linear_mpc
concepts.definition: LTI dynamics + quadratic cost + linear constraints. Reduces to QP per step. Real-time tractable. Substrate analogue: substrate's fast-optimization controller.

concepts.name: nonlinear_mpc
concepts.definition: NMPC. Nonlinear dynamics. Computationally expensive. Used in robotics, autonomous vehicles. Substrate analogue: substrate's full-nonlinear lookahead.

concepts.name: h_infinity_control
concepts.definition: H∞. Minimize worst-case disturbance amplification. Robust to model uncertainty + worst-case disturbance. Substrate analogue: substrate's adversarial-robust control.

concepts.name: mu_synthesis
concepts.definition: Structured singular value-based control synthesis. Handles structured uncertainty. Substrate analogue: substrate's parameter-uncertainty-robust controller.

concepts.name: robust_control
concepts.definition: Design for performance under worst-case uncertainty. Conservatism vs nominal performance tradeoff. Substrate analogue: substrate's worst-case-aware design.

concepts.name: particle_filter
concepts.definition: Sequential Monte Carlo. Represent posterior by weighted samples. Handles arbitrary nonlinear non-Gaussian. Substrate analogue: substrate's sample-based posterior.

concepts.name: bootstrap_filter
concepts.definition: Gordon+Salmond+Smith 1993. Standard particle filter: sample from prior, weight by likelihood, resample. Substrate analogue: substrate's sample-importance resampling.

concepts.name: rao_blackwellised_filter
concepts.definition: Particle filter where some state dimensions handled analytically (Kalman) + others by particles. Substrate analogue: substrate's hybrid analytic-sample estimation.

concepts.name: adaptive_control
concepts.definition: Controller parameters update online based on observed performance. Model reference + self-tuning. Substrate analogue: substrate's correction-coefficient learning.

concepts.name: model_reference_adaptive_control
concepts.definition: MRAC. Adjust controller so closed loop tracks reference model. Substrate analogue: substrate's target-tracking adaptation.

concepts.name: self_tuning_regulator
concepts.definition: STR. Identify plant online + design controller for current estimate. Substrate analogue: substrate's online system-identification + redesign.

concepts.name: gain_scheduling
concepts.definition: Pre-computed controller gains for different operating regions. Substrate analogue: substrate's per-context drive weights.

concepts.name: reinforcement_learning_control
concepts.definition: Modern RL = optimal control with unknown dynamics. Bellman equation reappears. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-coefficient learning via outcome.

concepts.name: policy_gradient_control
concepts.definition: Optimize policy parameters directly via gradient of expected return. Substrate analogue: substrate's correction-parameter optimization.

rules.name: lqr_principled_state_feedback
rules.head: Jabberwock has linear-Gaussian dynamics + quadratic cost
rules.body: the LQR solution is computed analytically from the Algebraic Riccati Equation. The resulting feedback is optimal AND inherits LQR robustness margins. Substrate's principled state-feedback.

rules.name: kalman_optimal_for_linear_gaussian
rules.head: Jabberwock estimates state under linear-Gaussian dynamics + noise
rules.body: Kalman filter is provably optimal (minimum mean squared error). Innovation drives belief update; Kalman gain weights prediction vs measurement.

rules.name: separation_principle_decouples_design
rules.head: Jabberwock has LQG problem
rules.body: estimator + controller designed independently. Their composition is optimal. Substrate's perception-action separation justified.

rules.name: mpc_handles_constraints_optimally
rules.head: Jabberwock has input or state constraints
rules.body: MPC handles them directly via constrained optimization at each step. LQR cannot. Substrate's constraint-aware control.

rules.name: h_infinity_for_worst_case_disturbance
rules.head: Jabberwock faces worst-case disturbances
rules.body: H∞ control minimizes worst-case amplification. Conservatism is the price. Substrate's adversarially-robust design.
